headline.title: WWDC 2026: Everything announced on Siri AI, iOS 27, Apple Intelligence and more
headline.summary: At WWDC 2026, Apple showcased enhancements to Siri, emphasizing a more advanced AI experience. The event also included updates on iOS 27 and developments in Apple Intelligence.

articles.title: For the 2nd time in weeks, Microsoft packages laced with credential stealer
articles.summary: Microsoft has identified 73 software packages that contain a self-replicating credential-stealing malware, which activates upon being opened by an AI agent. This incident marks the second occurrence within weeks of such malicious packages being discovered.

articles.title: Efficient tradeoffs and the safety-usefulness tradeoff model
articles.summary: The article discusses the "safety-usefulness tradeoff model," which posits that developers of AI systems must balance safety and usefulness, often prioritizing the latter due to limited willingness or ability to compromise. It challenges the assumption that developers make safety decisions solely based on cost efficiency, suggesting a more complex decision-making process.

articles.title: NotebookLM’s Gemini 3.5 upgrade adds a cloud computer and help finding sources
articles.summary: Google has announced updates to its AI-powered note-taking app, NotebookLM, which now incorporates the upgraded Gemini 3.5 model for improved accuracy and reliability. The new features include a cloud computer and enhanced assistance in finding sources.

articles.title: Apple just taught your iPhone to finish your sentences, your photos, and your workflows
articles.summary: Apple has introduced AI-powered enhancements to its Safari, Shortcuts, and Password apps, enabling features like sentence completion, photo suggestions, and streamlined workflows. These updates aim to improve user experience by leveraging artificial intelligence for more efficient task management.

articles.title: WWDC 2026: What to expect, from Siri’s highly anticipated revamp to Apple Intelligence and iOS 27
articles.summary: Apple's WWDC 2026 is expected to showcase a significant revamp of Siri, advancements in Apple Intelligence, and the introduction of iOS 27. The event will highlight new features and improvements aimed at enhancing user experience across Apple's ecosystem.

articles.title: Amazon is launching AI-generated custom merch
articles.summary: Amazon is introducing AI-generated custom merchandise through its print-on-demand service, allowing shoppers to create designs using text prompts via Alexa for Shopping. The generated images can be printed on various products, such as T-shirts and water bottles, and shared with others for purchase.

articles.title: Apple’s Image Playground doesn’t suck anymore
articles.summary: Apple's AI image generator, Image Playground, is undergoing significant improvements aimed at enhancing its competitiveness in the market. The updates are expected to address previous shortcomings and provide users with a more robust tool for image creation.

articles.title: Apple’s Photos app is getting new AI editing features
articles.summary: Apple's Photos app is introducing a new AI-driven "Reframe" feature that allows users to adjust perspectives in their images. This update aims to enhance photo editing capabilities by leveraging artificial intelligence for more dynamic adjustments.

articles.title: Apple’s long-awaited AI Siri overhaul is finally here
articles.summary: Apple has launched a significant overhaul of Siri, transforming it from a voice-controlled assistant into a more capable AI companion. The updated Siri aims to enhance user interaction by offering a broader range of functionalities.

articles.title: Apple’s New Siri AI Is Ready to Get Personal
articles.summary: Apple announced significant updates to Siri at WWDC 2026, including the introduction of a stand-alone app and a partnership with Google Gemini. These changes aim to enhance Siri's personalization and functionality for users.

articles.title: The UK Is Betting on a Billion-Dollar AI Supercomputer to Kick Its Addiction to US Tech
articles.summary: The UK government is investing in a billion-dollar AI supercomputer initiative aimed at reducing reliance on US technology and fostering the growth of domestic chip startups. This state-backed infrastructure project is part of a broader strategy to enhance the country's capabilities in artificial intelligence.
